command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

instruction: Create a complete lecture series on machine learning. 15 slides: Slide 1: 'Machine Learning Fundamentals'. Slide 2: course outline. Slide 3: what is ML - Venn diagram (3 overlapping circles: AI, ML, DL). Slide 4: types of learning (3 columns: Supervised, Unsupervised, Reinforcement). Slide 5: linear regression - axes and scatter dots with a line. Slide 6: decision tree diagram (connected ovals and rectangles in tree structure). Slide 7: neural network diagram (layers of circles connected by lines). Slide 8: training process flow diagram. Slide 9: bias-variance tradeoff chart (two crossing curves). Slide 10: model evaluation metrics table. Slide 11: confusion matrix (4-cell colored grid). Slide 12: cross-validation diagram (rectangle divided into colored sections). Slide 13: real-world applications (4 case study cards). Slide 14: ethical considerations. Slide 15: resources and next steps. Use academic blue (#1565C0) and white. Save as 'ML_Course.pptx' on the Desktop.
